name: Synthetic Food-Grade EP Calcium Sulfonate Grease
short_description:
Our Synthetic Food Grade Calcium Sulfonate Grease (MSL-3157SFGEPCSG) is a next-generation H1 food-grade lubricant engineered for the most demanding applications in the food industry. Formulated with food-grade over-based calcium complex thickeners, antioxidants, and advanced extreme-pressure and anti-wear additives, this grease outperforms other calcium-based, clay-based, and aluminum complex greases.

MSL-3157SFGEPCSG meets USDA H1 requirements for incidental food contact, is ISO 21469 certified, and complies with FDA 21 CFR 178.3570.

 

Additional Information:

  • Resistant to wear
  • Suitable for water-prone applications
  • Rust protection
  • High-temperature characteristics
  • Extreme-pressure and anti-wear properties
  • Long bear and machine life

name: Universal 10000 Hour Compressor Fluid
short_description:
Our compressor fluid (MSL-6321UCF10) is formulated to provide complete compatibility with a wide variety of OEM and aftermarket rotary screw compressor lubricants. Flushing is not required to switch to MSL-6321UCF10; in most cases, it can be added directly on top of the existing compressor oil. Its advanced formulation helps avoid costly lubricant-contamination mistakes and helps streamline product inventory.

MSL-6321UCF10 is also formulated to provide outstanding resistance against wear, rust, corrosion and sludge buildup, and to provide 10,000 hours of service.

 

Additional Information:

  • 10,000-hour oil life at 100°C discharge temperature
  • Compatible with most OEM PAG compressor lubricants
  • Resists water contamination
  • Protects against wear, rust and corrosion
  • Non-toxic/non-hazardous

name: Premium Ammonia Refrigeration Compressor Oil
short_description:
Our NXT 717 Compressor Oil (MSL-NXT717) represents the next generation of 2-stage hydrocracked ammonia refrigeration lubricants. This lubricant is an enhanced version of the technology used by most OEMs. It offers reduced solubility with ammonia, less oil carryover, and better pumpability even under extremely low-temperature conditions.

MSL-NXT717 is also completely top-off compatible with most normal paraffinics, naphthenics, alkylbenzenes, PAOs, and single-stage hydrocracked products.

 

Additional Information:

  • Formulated specifically for use in ammonia refrigeration systems
  • Very low oil carryover rates, 50-80% less than competitor formulations
  • Long-lasting formulation, significantly increases fluid life
  • Reduced lubricant use
  • Less viscosity dilution due to lower ammonia solubility
  • For use in applications with evaporator temperatures down to -45°C
  • Compatible with most competitive fluids, no flushing required

name: Synthetic Food-Grade Low Temperature Chain Lubricant
short_description:
Our Synthetic Food Grade Freezer Chain Lubricant (MSL-6831SFGLTCL) is engineered for spiral freezer systems, including cryogenic freezing applications. Blended with advanced synthetic base fluids and additives, it delivers outstanding cold-temperature fluidity and superior wear protection in extreme environments. MSL-6831SFGLTCL meets H1 requirements for incidental food contact and complies with FDA 21 CFR 178.3570. It also offers excellent water separation, rust and corrosion resistance, and stays firmly in place to prevent fling-off while providing long-lasting chain lubrication.

 

Additional Information:

  • Meets H1 requirements for incidental food contact (FDA 21 CFR 178.3570)
  • Enhanced lubrication and superior protection at low temperatures
  • Excellent film strength and anti-wear properties
  • Maintains fluidity at cold temperatures
  • Resists fling-off and remains on the chain for maximum lubrication and protection
  • High stability and demulsibility in wet environments
  • Resistant against rust, corrosion and other deposits
